coordinateOperation: Inverse of UTM zone 37N + Adindan to WGS 84 (1) + axis order change (2D)
operationPipeline: proj=pipeline step inv proj=utm zone=37 a=6378249.145 rf=293.465 step inv proj=longlat a=6378249.145 rf=293.465 step proj=push v_3 step proj=cart a=6378249.145 rf=293.465 step proj=helmert x=-166 y=-15 z=204 step inv proj=cart ellps=WGS84 step proj=pop v_3 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
boundaryComparison: Bidirectional boundary Hausdorff distance in a local WGS84 azimuthal equidistant frame; no clipping, simplification, repair or fitted displacement.
limitations: CRS handling is checked independently; source survey accuracy and basemap accuracy are not established.
WGS84 is an ensemble: no observation epoch is inferred from an EPSG code.
